confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Chengdu price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain; accommodation tiers are less certain because hotel rates vary with season and venue. The FX value (0.6955, as at 4.00 pm 15 Oct 2026) came from a search-result summary of the RBA homepage. I did not open the page to verify it, and the summary did not show the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other large inland Sichuan and western Chinese provincial capitals with similar local dining, café and mid-range hotel pricing, using mainland Chinese price levels converted at prevailing CNY/USD rates.
